description:
QSIG gold macro context in one call, point-in-time correct. Returns:
    regime (trend-state label: ranging, trending or mixed, with since and
    hours_in_regime), positioning_cot (CFTC managed-money and commercials net,
    weekly change, share of open interest, extreme flag, with report_date and
    the official released_at), rates (FRED 10-year real yield and breakeven
    inflation with 30-day change), geo (QSIG GeoRisk score and gold-linked
    Polymarket theme stress) and analogs (the 5 most similar past gold
    episodes and what followed them over 24h and 72h).

    as_of is an optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp such as "2026-09-01T12:00:00Z".
    The hourly snapshot at or before it is returned AS IT WAS KNOWABLE THEN:
    a COT report counts only after its Friday release, analogs use a 7-day
    embargo so every outcome had closed. Use it for backtests without
    look-ahead. History begins 2026-07-14. asset accepts only "gold" in v1.

    Every block carries status (ok, stale or missing) and knowable_at.
    recorded=true rows were written live; recorded=false rows were filled from
    stored history. Analog outcomes are history, not a forecast.

    This is a MEASURED STATE, not a forecast. No prices, no direction.
    Paid route: $0.02 USDC via x402. Call get_gold_context_fields first (free)
    for field definitions and the available history range.
name: get_gold_context
